searchText: The new release of evmone contains "fixture" with state and EOF tests. Happy testing. https://github.com/ethereum/evmone/releases/tag/v0.12.0 Few tests have `Osaka` hardfork (for example `create_nested_in_txcreate`, `txcreate_auxdata_longer_than_declared`) Yes, we moved the `TXCREATE` impl to Osaka :/ Could we for EOF test use `PragueEOF` name? EEST uses `Prague` for eof tests Prague currently uses `CancunEIP7692` https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/blob/c6152f078c1ec572d488df8558b7ab8b7fdef6b1/tests/prague/eip7692_eof_v1/__init__.py#L5 - I would support both `Prague` or `PragueEIP7692`, but I don't think we want vanilla `Prague` until the next devnet is the one we are adding EOF. `Prague` and `PragueEIP7692` could work, there was chats before to use `PragueEOF` this is a reason why I mention it. an update from devnet land. We're currently on devnet-2. The plan is to launch devnet-3 soon, once all the 7702 changes are done and implemented, the idea is to focus on testing 7702 for devnet-3. We're aiming for EOF in devnet-4, ideally triggered by `pragueTime`, as that is what we'd use on mainnet. Devnet 4 aligns with what we discussed in the implementers call. What's the timeframe... 2 weeks per devnet? Yeah i'd say that's roughly correct, depends on how long changes take for the client teams of course and if we find major issues we might want to relaunch or re-do a devnet.
